scripts.dev: bunx concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "cd server && DEV_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000 cargo run" "next dev --port 3000"
scripts.build: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE= next build && cd server && cargo build --release
scripts.start: bun run build && cd server && STATIC_DIR=../out SCENARIOS_DIR=../scenarios ./target/release/oauth-mcp-server
scripts.test: cd server && cargo test -q && cd .. && bun test tests/
